quote: Z. H. Sun and Z. W. Sun showed in 1992 that if the first case of Fermat's Last Theorem was false for a certain prime p, then p would have to be a Wall–Sun–Sun prime
posed_by: Zhi Hong Sun and Zhi Wei Sun
note: The conjecture was formally posed in 1992, though Donald Dines Wall's foundational work on the Pisano period dates to 1960. The conjecture is named after both Wall and the Sun brothers.
